SMALL CLAIMS HEARING OF JAN-11-2022 - CONTINUED FOR PROGRESS REPORT TO FEB-25-2022 AT 10:00 AM IN DEPT. 506. PLAINTIFFS MARJOLAINE GRAPPE AND DAVID THOMSON ARE PRESENT. DEFENDANT JOAN DOWNEY IS PRESENT. DEFENDANT WAIVES PROOF OF SERVICE. PLAINTIFF EXHIBTS ARE RETAINED. DEFENDANT EXHIBITS ARE REVIEWED AND RETURNED IN OPEN COURT. SETTLEMENT AGREEMENT IN THE AMOUNT OF $3,875.00 IS MADE. DEFENDANT TO PAY EITHER BY VENMO OR CHECK. ORDER RE: CONTINUANCE FOR PROGRESS REPORT. IF NO APPEARANCES, CASE DISMISSED WITH PREJUDICE AS SETTLED. (SEE SCANNED DOCUMENT FOR DETAILS)
